name: Demand Generation Specialist
description: Executes multi-channel marketing campaigns within Sales, Distribution & Marketing, defining campaign objectives, budgets, and editorial calendars to drive demand. Produces creative content, manages social media and SEO operations, and forecasts campaign reach and ROI. Routes materials through compliance and brand review, ensuring all external assets meet codified brand guidelines.

name: Demand Manager
description: Manages initiative intake and investment prioritization for the Program Management Office, logging demand requests, assessing strategic fit, and routing qualified initiatives to the intake committee. Operates portfolio governance, assembling committee decision packs and following open actions to closure. Analyzes spend variances, capacity gaps, and in-year budget reallocation to keep the portfolio on plan.

name: DevOps / Platform Automation Engineer
description: Builds and operates platform automation across Technology & Engineering, delivering infrastructure-as-code, data pipeline CI/CD, and environment lifecycle management. Maintains cloud security posture, certificate management, and secret handling, reporting posture drift to governance. Governs the CMDB, retires deprecated IaC modules, and runs integration tests and deployment debriefs on every release.

name: DevOps Engineer
description: Owns release coordination and change management across Technology & Engineering, managing release scope, calendars, patch execution, and emergency changes under change policy governance. Builds CI/CD pipelines with segregation-of-duties controls, container and IaC security scanning, and secret management. Operates the central observability platform and scores change risk with documented compensating controls.

name: Digital Channel Manager
description: Manages digital distribution channels within Sales, Distribution & Marketing, supporting producer pipelines from prospect targeting through bound submissions logged in the CRM. Oversees agency and broker relationship governance and delegated authority arrangements, monitoring corrective actions and securing compliance sign-off on partner materials. Shapes distribution operating-model design and documents channel roles and accountability.

name: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Delivers digital marketing for distribution channels within Sales, Distribution & Marketing, building target prospect lists from white-space analysis and market data by line and geography. Supports producer pipelines and retention cross-sell analytics, updating forecasts and archiving campaign performance data. Applies marketing governance standards, obtaining compliance sign-off on partner materials before release.

name: Disability Case Manager
description: Manages ongoing disability claims within the Claims value stream, evaluating liability, documenting decisions, and notifying file owners. Handles denial management, logging denials in the claims system and scheduling appeal follow-ups, and supports structured settlement placement and retained asset accounts. Tracks RSA compliance and reports to regulators on schedule, keeping claim routing and recoveries reconciled.

name: Disability Claims Intake Specialist
description: Performs first-notice-of-loss intake for disability claims, routing new claims through workflow rules, monitoring routing exceptions, and rebalancing misrouted files. Supports liability evaluation and denial handling by documenting decisions, logging outcomes in the claims platform, and setting appeal follow-ups. Tracks RSA compliance obligations and posts recovery receipts to the claims ledger.

name: Disaster Recovery Engineer
description: Operates disaster recovery and backup infrastructure supporting Cybersecurity & IAM resilience, maintaining offsite and immutable backup copies and testing restoration for critical systems. Sets RTO/RPO targets per IT service, runs the annual DR test schedule including ransomware recovery exercises, and documents outcomes. Compiles test evidence for cyber continuity regulatory reporting and maintains DR runbooks.

name: Disaster Recovery Manager
description: Leads business continuity management within Risk, Compliance & Audit, governing the BCM programme, business impact analyses, and important business service definitions. Schedules and executes continuity tests across critical services, raising remediation actions and re-assessing residual vulnerabilities annually. Oversees IT disaster recovery planning, incident response governance, and post-crisis communications reviews.

name: Distribution Analyst
description: Analyzes distribution performance across Sales, Distribution & Marketing, building channel dashboards, scoring customers into propensity deciles, and engineering features from customer and policy history. Supports delegated authority oversight and ongoing producer compliance monitoring, from quote-to-bind support through termination governance. Reviews channel marketing spend efficiency and reconciles producer onboarding handoffs.

name: Distribution Operations Manager
description: Oversees distribution operations within Sales, Distribution & Marketing, running agency and broker relationship governance and delegated authority oversight. Manages producer pipeline support and training, tracking corrective actions to completion and escalating overdue items. Enforces marketing governance standards, securing compliance sign-off on partner materials and documenting distribution roles and accountability.

name: Distribution Specialist
description: Coordinates day-to-day distribution activities within Sales, Distribution & Marketing, logging bound submission outcomes in the CRM and maintaining pipeline forecasts. Supports agency and broker relationship governance and producer training, monitoring corrective actions and compliance sign-offs on partner materials. Contributes to customer insights reporting and prospect targeting from white-space and market analysis.
